parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup plan.

If your instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, use the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html feature to add the RDS instance to DBS and obtain the backup plan ID

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the destination sandbox instance. The zone must be supported by PrivateLink. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469326.html operation to query the list of zones in a specific region.

Before using the sandbox feature, enable https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459882.html. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469322.html operation to enable PrivateLink
parameters.help_zh:

使用沙箱功能前需要先开通https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459882.html服务，可通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/469322.html接口开通私网连接服务
